Bigfoot believers and those who are curious will have a chance to hear from several prominent researchers when a town hall dedicated to the legendary creature comes to Victoria this week.

The Victoria Bigfoot Town Hall is set for Sept. 17, at the SNGEQU Conference Centre at the University of Victoria, bringing together researchers and investigators to discuss alleged Bigfoot sightings, eyewitness encounters and other unexplained phenomena.

The event features four speakers: Bigfoot researcher and author Matt Pruitt; explorer and author Adam Davies; Ryan “RPG” Golembeske, known for his work on Bigfoot, cryptids and paranormal investigations; and Jonathan “Redbird” Dover, a retired Navajo Nation law enforcement officer and paranormal investigator.

Pruitt has worked in Bigfoot research and field investigations across North America and was involved with the television series Finding Bigfoot. He is also a producer of the Bigfoot and Beyond podcast.

Davies has travelled to remote locations around the world investigating reports of creatures including the Orang Pendek in Sumatra, the Yeti in the Himalayas, Bigfoot in North America and Florida’s Skunk Ape.

Golembeske has investigated reported Bigfoot and paranormal encounters, combining eyewitness interviews and field investigations with technology and other investigative techniques.

Dover spent more than three decades as a Navajo Ranger investigating reports involving unexplained phenomena, including Bigfoot sightings, UFOs and other paranormal claims. His work has also appeared on Netflix’s Unsolved Mysteries and the History Channel’s The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch.

General admission is $50, while VIP packages are $100. Admission is free for Alaska Bigfoot Cruise passengers and Multi-Con Pass holders, according to the event organizers.
